entry.title: Generativetober Day 27 - Dumb
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'left') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'left') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Dumbo {
  constructor(x, y, c) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = random(0, 100);
    this.ty = random(9999, 99999);
    this.color = c;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -1, 1);
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -1, 1);

    if (this.x > width-30 || this.x < 30) {
      this.x = width/2;
    }

    if (this.y > height-30 || this.y < 30) {
      this.y = height/2;
    }

    this.tx += 0.01;
    this.ty += 0.01;
  }

  show() {
    fill(this.color);
    circle(this.x, this.y, 3);

    stroke(this.color);
    noFill();

    let r = random(1, 10);
    let pl = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'left');
    let pr = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'right');
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pl.x-5, pl.y+5,
      pl.x-5, pl.y-5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pr.x+5, pr.y-5,
      pr.x+5, pr.y+5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
  }
}

let ds = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);

  for (let i = 0; i < 50; ++i) {
    ds.push(new Dumbo(random(0, width), random(0, height), random(colors)));
  }
}

function draw() {
  background(0);
  noStroke();

  for (let d of ds) {
    d.update();
    d.show();
  }

  fill(white);
  stroke(white);
  textSize(16);
  text("Dumb", 10, height-10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("dumb.png");
  }
}

entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'ccw') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'ccw') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Zipper {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.dirx = random([-1, 1]);
    this.diry = random([-1, 1]);
    this.alph = 255;
    this.dira = -1;
    this.color = white;
  }

  update() {
    this.alph += this.dira;
    stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    
    this.x += this.dirx * 5;
    
    this.y += this.diry * 7;

    if (this.x >= width-30 || this.x <= 30) {
      this.dirx *= -1;
      this.x = random(30,width-30);
      this.lastx = this.x;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.y >= height-30 || this.y <= 30) {
      this.diry *= -1;
      this.y = random(30,height-30);
      this.lasty = this.y;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.alph >= 255 || this.alph <= 0) {
      this.dira *= -1;
    }
  }

  show() {
    line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    
    const p2 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'ccw');
    line(this.x, this.y, p2.x, p2.y);

    const p3 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'right');
    line(this.x, this.y, p3.x, p3.y);
  }
}

let z;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);

  z = new Zipper(width/2, height/2);

  noStroke();
  fill(255);
  textSize(16);
  text("Zip", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  z.update();
  z.show();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("zip.png");
  }
}

entry.content:

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Fracture {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = 0;
    this.ty = 10000;
    this.dirx = random([-1,1]);
    this.diry = random([-1,1]);
  }

  update() {
    this.tx += 0.01;
    let distx = map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, 5, 20);
    let disty = map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, 5, 20);
    
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += distx * this.dirx + random(-40,40);
    this.y += disty * this.diry + random(-40,40);
  }

  show() {
    if (this.x > 0 && this.x < width && this.y > 0 && this.y < height) {
      stroke(...random([white,cyan]), random([50, 100, 150, 200, 250]));
      line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
      if (random() < 0.5) {
        stroke(...random([white,cyan]), random([50, 100, 150, 200, 250]));
        line(
          this.x + random(-3, 3),
          this.y + random(-3, 3),
          this.lastx + random(-3, 3),
          this.lasty + random(-3, 3)
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

let fracture;
let fractures = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  for (let i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
    fractures.push(new Fracture(
      random(width/2-20,width/2+20), random(height/2+20, height/2-20)));
  }
  
  fill(...white, 25);

  fill(white);
  textSize(16);
  text("Fracture", 10, height-10);

  stroke(255);
}

function draw() {
  for (let f of fractures) {
    f.update();
    f.show();
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("fracture.png");
  }
}

entry.content:

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  noStroke();
  fill(...white, 25);
}

let tx1 = 0;
let tx2 = 500;
let ty1 = 10000;
let nLayers = 13;

function draw() {
  background(0);
  
  for (let i = 1; i < nLayers; i++) {
    fill(255, map(i, 1, nLayers, 255, 88), 255, 5*i);
    let n1 = noise(tx1+i);
    let slice = height/nLayers;
    
    bezier(
      width/2,
      50+i*10,
      
      map(noise(tx1+i), 0, 1, width/2-50, width/2),
      slice*i,
      
      map(noise(tx2+i), 0, 1, width/2-400, width/2),
      map(noise(ty1+i), 0, 1, height-200, height),
      
      width/2,
      height
    );

    bezier(
      width/2,
      50+i*10,
      
      map(noise(tx1+i), 0, 1, width/2+50, width/2),
      slice*i,
      
      map(noise(tx2+i), 0, 1, width/2+400, width/2),
      map(noise(ty1+i), 0, 1, height-200, height),
      
      width/2,
      height
    );

    tx1 += 0.001;
    tx2 += 0.002;
    ty1 += 0.003;
  }

  
  fill(magenta);
  textSize(16);
  text("Bake", 10, height-10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("bake.png");
  }
}

entry.title: Generativetober Day 23 - Dapper
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Walker {
  constructor(x, y, c, leftbound, rightbound, topbound, botbound) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.leftbound = leftbound;
    this.rightbound = rightbound;
    this.topbound = topbound;
    this.botbound = botbound;
    this.color = c;
    this.tx = 0;
    this.ty = 10000;
    this.visited = [];
  }

  update() {
    this.tx += 0.01;
    this.ty += 0.01;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -5, 5);
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -3, 3);
    
    if (this.x < this.leftbound) this.x = this.leftbound;
    else if (this.x > this.rightbound) this.x = this.rightbound;

    if (this.y < this.topbound) this.y = this.topbound;
    else if (this.y > this.botbound) this.y = this.botbound;

    if (random() < 0.25) {
      this.visited.push([this.x,this.y]);
    }
  }

  show() {
    stroke(0, 55);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.visited.length; ++i) {
      // hack for line length, replace with width probably
      line(this.visited[i][0]-50, this.visited[i][1], 
           this.visited[i][0]+50, this.visited[i][1]);
    }
  }
}

class Dapper {
  constructor(x, y, w, h) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.w = w;
    this.h = h;
    this.walker = new Walker(x+w/2, y+h, 0,
                            10+w/2, // left boundary
                            width-w/2-10, // right boundary
                            height/2, // top boundary
                            height-10); // bottom boundary
  }

  update() {
    this.walker.update();
    this.x = this.walker.x - this.w/2;
    this.y = this.walker.y - this.h;
  }

  show() {
    // path
    this.walker.show();
    
    // body
    stroke(0);
    fill(0);
    rect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);

    // undercolor
    stroke(255);
    fill(255);
    triangle(this.x, this.y + this.h/4,
            this.x+this.w, this.y + this.h/4,
            this.x+this.w/2, this.y + this.h/1.5);
    const underheight = (this.y + this.h/1.5) - (this.y + this.h/4);

    // accents
    stroke(magenta);
    fill(magenta);
    const centerline = this.x + this.w/2;
    const accenty = this.y + this.h/4 + underheight/9;
    const accentwidth = this.w / 10;
    const accentheight = accentwidth / 1.5;
    triangle(centerline, accenty,
            centerline-accentwidth, accenty - accentheight,
            centerline-accentwidth, accenty + accentheight);
    triangle(centerline, accenty,
            centerline+accentwidth, accenty - accentheight,
            centerline+accentwidth, accenty + accentheight);
  }
}

let d;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640,640);
  background(cyan);
  d = new Dapper(width/3, height/2-100, 100, 200);
}

function draw() {
  background(cyan);
  d.update();
  d.show();

  stroke(255);
  fill(0);
  textSize(16);
  text("Dapper", 10, height - 10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("dapper.png");
  }
}

Discussion

I got nothin' here... Dapper? I ended up first making a little dapper dude with proportionally drawn tuxedo and bow tie and then decided to make him walker around on a plane drawing faded lines for his path. I like only drawing some of the lines and drawing them with some alpha. I want to explore this more.
